title: Retained Windows capture-job drainer can wait forever for a job notification that is not guaranteed
outcome: A capture job held in pending custody is certified complete once its members have actually exited, even if the job completion port never delivers the final notification, so pending_jobs and the root lease do not outlive the processes.
acceptance: the retained-job drainer re-checks the positive completion certificate without depending on a job notification arriving
a regression in which the final notification is suppressed still releases the pending job once its members have exited, and never releases it before
